name: immigration-filing-drafter
display_name: Immigration Filing & Status Update Drafting Skill
description: One skill: /immigration-filing. Provide case facts and your firm's own filing templates; the skill drafts narrative filing sections (support letters, cover letters, RFE-response outlines) strictly from what's supplied, and drafts a client status-update email when you report a status change. Assisted draft, always reviewed — never looks up or submits anything to USCIS, never invents a fact, never predicts an outcome, never computes a deadline.
